description: This file defines the SugarLogStore class which implements the Store interface to handle logging metrics from monitors in the SuiteCRM system. It includes method implementations for flushing metrics to the log and handles external dependencies such as the Store interface and global logging object.

classes.name: SugarLogStore
classes.description: A class that implements the Store interface, responsible for logging metrics from monitor objects.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Creates a log entry with metrics collected from a monitor object.
